minimal_failure_capture_plan.method: Separately reviewed bounded observation launcher with sys.settrace and runpy.run_path of the exact frozen recorder_v3; no monkeypatch and no original source edits.
setup: Authenticate launcher source/arguments independently and preserve exact original recorder and dependency hashes before running.

Set sys.argv for the original CLI and runpy.run_path(original_recorder_path,run_name="__main__"). Record the real outer process argv and tool session honestly; a wrapper is a distinct invocation, not the original direct CLI.
Install a global trace returning a local trace only for the exact frozen protocol_v4 lock_proof code/file. All other call frames returnNone.
The local callback handles only exception events carrying the exact RuntimeError message. Keep a strict once-only capture cap and no model/native imports.
failure_time_capture: Copy the original failing frame locals raw, matches, owner, lock, actual and the relevant stat fields from info before any replacement observation. This is the primary evidence for the failed check.

Walk active parent frames to the exact original recorder.run frame and obtain its already-held fd; for acquisition failures the acquire_lock frame may instead hold fd. Never open/acquire another serial flock.
Read os.fstat(fd), fcntl.F_GETFD, /proc/self/fdinfo/<fd>, /proc/self/fd/<fd> target and actual process identity. F_GETFD only proves fd validity, not lock ownership.
Optionally read one additional bounded /proc/locks and record PID namespace link. Label all these as later observations, not replacements for the original raw.

Validate capture sizes and save immutable exclusive diagnostic JSON while the original finally has not yet run, or retain an in-memory capture for later exclusive persistence. No source hashing/model work from the exception callback.
preservation: Never suppress, replace, retry or reinterpret the original exception. Trace callback capture failure must be separately recorded or ignored without changing the original exception propagation.
Original recorder.run remains solely responsible for acquire/release and its finally executes normally. The same original error must still produce nonzero outer exit.
No target success receipt is created unless the unchanged original recorder itself completes all checks.
The tracer is diagnostic with timing overhead; it cannot be used in a performance window or counted as native/model/quality qualification.
Do not repair by adding blind retries, accepting missing global entries, fabricating old success, or changing the already-executed frozen runner closure.
minimal_failure_capture_plan.future_robustness: If captured evidence demonstrates a global-table-only observation defect while exact descriptor-specific FLOCK ownership remains intact, design and independently review a successor proof that binds the original fd, exact inode/device, actual owner and0 EOF lock extent before and after the observation. Do not replace or relax the existing proof based solely on the20000-pass diagnostic.
